inlines.v: CUPBOARD, noun [cup and board.] Originally, a board or shelf for cups to stand on. In modern houses, a small case or inclosure in a room with shelves destined to receive cups, plates, dishes and the like. CUPBOARD, verb transitive To collect into a cupboard; to hoard. [Not used.]
